hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template K(n)*theta(n) by specializing the function parameter theta to a or b, while keeping the repeated kernel factor K(n) fixed.
required_assumptions: K, a, and b are scalar-valued functions of n
multiplication is left-factor associative as written
hypotheses.rationale: The two additive terms are substitution instances of the same left-multiplicative template with a shared K(n). This identifies the CSE-shared factor K(n) as the repeated kernel and explains the LGG family without rewriting the full sum.
